description: We are a passionate team of aspiring innovators excited to explore space technology through game development. Our goal is to create an interactive Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer that makes space exploration fun and educational, allowing young learners to experience astronaut challenges, manage resources, make mission decisions, and understand life on the Moon and Mars.
summary:
ASTRA (Astronaut Training System) is a browser-based educational space exploration platform designed to introduce students to astronaut training and lunar mission operations.

The project features four interactive modules: Flight Systems, Microgravity, Lunar Operations and Outpost Command. Students can explore simulated spacesuit systems, experience simplified microgravity movement, collect lunar geological samples and manage essential resources in a five-day lunar outpost mission.

ASTRA also includes a NASA-referenced Facts Library and interactive knowledge assessments to reinforce scientific concepts.

The project aims to make space science more accessible through interactive learning and game-based exploration. Its scientific content is informed by NASA educational and technical resources, while its gameplay mechanics are simplified educational simulations.

ASTRA is an independent student project, not an official NASA product.
details:
ASTRA was developed as an interactive educational platform combining space science with game-based learning.

How it works:
The platform uses four training modules. Flight Systems introduces simulated EVA spacesuit life-support systems. Microgravity demonstrates simplified astronaut movement and inertia. Lunar Operations allows users to explore a simulated lunar environment and collect geological samples. Outpost Command challenges users to manage oxygen, water, power, food and radiation-shielding reserves across five mission days.

Educational impact:
ASTRA helps students understand space exploration concepts through interactive experiences, scientific explanations and mission assessments.

Technology used:
HTML, CSS and JavaScript, developed using Visual Studio Code and published through GitHub Pages.

NASA resources:
NASA educational materials and technical references inform the Facts Library and scientific mission content.

Creative approach:
The project combines realistic space-inspired environments, astronaut illustrations, interactive simulations and educational assessments. Movement, telemetry and resource values are simplified gameplay representations rather than real spacecraft measurements.

Accessibility:
ASTRA is designed for desktop and mobile web browsers, with keyboard and touch-based controls.
